parameters.query:
WITH payload AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS value), resumed AS (
  UPDATE analysis_runs SET workflow_execution_id = $2::text, status = 'queued', error = '', finished_at = NULL, heartbeat_at = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW()
  FROM payload
  WHERE id = NULLIF(payload.value->>'resume_run_id', '')::uuid
    AND tenant_id = payload.value->>'tenant_id' AND status = 'failed'
  RETURNING id, status, current_step, created_at, request
), created AS (
  INSERT INTO analysis_runs (history_id, workflow_execution_id, status, current_step, request, tenant_id, access_groups, decision_state)
  SELECT COALESCE(value->>'history_id', ''), $2::text, 'queued', 'queued', value,
    value->>'tenant_id', ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(value->'access_groups')),
    jsonb_build_object('steps', '{}'::jsonb, 'evidence_index', '{}'::jsonb, 'conflicts', '[]'::jsonb, 'open_questions', '[]'::jsonb, 'revisions', '[]'::jsonb)
  FROM payload WHERE COALESCE(value->>'resume_run_id', '') = ''
  RETURNING id, status, current_step, created_at, request
)
SELECT id::text AS run_id, status, current_step, created_at, request FROM resumed
UNION ALL
SELECT id::text AS run_id, status, current_step, created_at, request FROM created;

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ accepted: true, run_id: $('Create Queued Analysis Run').first().json.run_id, status: 'queued', current_step: 'queued', status_url: '/api/v1/analysis/spatial-strategy/runs/' + $('Create Queued Analysis Run').first().json.run_id }) }}
